page: Microsoft Azure EC48es_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEV6 server family. It is powered by dedicated Intel processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs. However, it is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing the attachment of high-performance external storage volumes to meet disk I/O requirements. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the EC48es_v6 offers a high-density memory allocation relative to its compute cores, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the overhead of local storage maintenance. It is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
